# Version history

## v1.6.0

### Additions
- Added Ghost Luigis for all 21 regular Power Stars.
- Added compatibility with Korean and Asian (Taiwan, Hong Kong) releases of SMG2.
- Added support for the following languages:
  - Chinese (traditional)
  - Korean
  - French
  - Spanish
- Lubba now informs the player about Co-Star Mode after collecting the first Power Star.
- Custom music tracks now include chord information for Launch Star and Coin sounds.
- The Star List now tracks progress for the Comet Observatory.
- **Starship Mario**: Added a Golden Mushroom to the Starshroom.
- **Galactic Garden Galaxy**: Added flower petals on the path to the Space Junk block sections.
- **Sweet Treat Galaxy**: Added a set of decorative balloons near the birthday cake planet.
- **Eep Beep Galaxy**: Added a small square platform in the penultimate section of the Comet mission to improve gameplay flow.
- **Comet Observatory**: Replaced the Purple Luma in the second mission with the original SMG1 Comet Luma.

### Changes
- Players are now immediately teleported back from the teleporter bonus rooms upon collecting all main items.
- Players are now booted out upon collecting a Green Star only if no remaining accessible Green Stars can be reached without resetting or dying.
- All boss cutscenes can now be skipped on recurring encounters.
- Sprangler Cocoons now have collision and reflect shot Star Bits.
- Co-Star Luma's Spin Attack can now defeat Ice Bats.
- Ice Mario's attack can now defeat Fuzzies.
- Improved lighting across various levels.
- Updated and cleaned up dialogue and text across several areas.
- **Starship Mario**: Toads now reference Golden Mushrooms instead of 1-Ups.
- **World Map**: The Green Star cutscene no longer displays the Grand World Map.
- **World Map**: The background now displays the lens flare effect properly.
- **Galactic Garden Galaxy**: Slightly moved the Cloud Flower and Space Junk block sections.
- **Sweet Treat Galaxy**: Various decorative background objects were rearranged.
- **Gloomy Galleon Galaxy**: Generated air bubbles now remain active longer.
- **Gloomy Galleon Galaxy**: Bonefins now use the restored sounds from SMG1.
- **Gloomy Galleon Galaxy**: Adjusted the underwater camera filter for a clearer view.
- **Gloomy Galleon Galaxy**: Gringills now appear only during the Comet to reduce lag.
- **Gloomy Galleon Galaxy**: Lowered the amount of seaweed to reduce lag.
- **Turnlog Galaxy**: Adjusted the gravity on the arrow slope.
- **Turnlog Galaxy**: Re-recorded Cosmic Spirit input playback.
- **Eep Beep Galaxy**: Adjusted the Beat Block arrangements in the large stairway section to minimize waiting time.
- **Eep Beep Galaxy**: The level music now continues playing after a Power Star spawns.
- **Comet Observatory**: The book in the library can no longer be targeted by Co-Star Luma.
- Performed various internal cleanups and code optimization.

### Bugfixes
- Fixed object pop-in across multiple galaxies.
- Message boxes no longer cover the Cosmic Spirit during dialogues.
- **Sweet Treat Galaxy**: Players no longer bump against the floor when landing on the birthday cake planet.
- **Gloomy Galleon Galaxy**: Sandy platforms now display the player's footprints when walked on.
- **Battle Blast Galaxy**: The Stamp no longer appears during the Comet mission.
- **Battle Blast Galaxy**: Recreated the Topman planet's collision to fix shadow glitches.
- **Turnlog Galaxy**: Updated the planet collision to fix shadow glitches.
- **Turnlog Galaxy**: Lines and circles of Star Bits no longer clip through the floor.
- **Eep Beep Galaxy**: The camera no longer clips through the platform during the second Green Star's cutscene.
- **Kraken King Galaxy**: The Chance Cube now rotates properly.

### Removals
- The "World 1" title is no longer displayed anywhere in the game since the mod only contains one world.
- **Sweet Treat Galaxy**: The brownish Li'l Cinder variant was removed in favor of the original enemy kind.
- **Kraken King Galaxy**: Removed the death barrier between the airship and UFO sections.
- **Comet Observatory**: Removed redundant books from the library.
